name: Surf 'n' Turf Ribeye with Bacon-Wrapped Scallops, Asparagus, Tomatoes & Parmesan New Potatoes

instructions.primary_message: If using wooden skewers, place 4-6 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
340 g new potatoes
½ small bunch asparagus
½ pint grape tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Halve potatoes and transfer to a baking sheet pan. Drizzle with oil and season with spices. Toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp Italian seasoning
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place potatoes in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until starting to soften, about 15 minutes.

Meanwhile, snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus. Transfer to another baking sheet, along with tomatoes. Drizzle with oil and season with spices. Toss to coat and spread out in an even layer. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp basil, dried
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Finely grate Parmesan and set aside.
Cut bacon in half crosswise to yield 8 short strips.
Pat scallops dry with paper towels and place on a plate. Wrap scallops with the bacon strips and thread onto skewers. Return to the plate and set aside.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on another plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
340 g ribeye steak
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate, cover with aluminum foil, and set aside to rest.

When the potatoes are starting to soften, remove from the oven, stir, and sprinkle with Parmesan. Return to the oven, along with the asparagus and tomatoes. Roast until potatoes and asparagus are fork-tender and tomatoes start to burst, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven.

Return the grill pan to medium-high heat and coat with more oil. Add scallop skewers and grill, turning occasionally, until scallops are cooked through and bacon is crispy, 6-8 minutes. Add to the plate with the steak.
Using a clean cutting board, thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide potatoes, asparagus, tomatoes, steak, and bacon-wrapped scallops between plates. Enjoy!
